description: Reads during an active effect register dependencies (track); writes schedule the dependent effects (trigger).
A function Vue re-runs when its dependencies change: component render, computed getter, watcher.
Queues component updates and watchers and flushes them in a microtask, batching synchronous changes.
Promise that resolves after the current update flush, when the DOM reflects the latest state.
Signal algorithm by Johnson Chu that powers `@vue/reactivity` in Vue 3.6.
Vue 3.6 opt-in SFC compilation mode without virtual DOM: DOM is created once and patched by fine-grained effects.
Collects effects created inside it so they can be stopped together.
